project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Transforms
project.description: The GENERIC named-transform function pool only (date/string/number formatting, country-code resolution, and similarly domain-agnostic utilities) - deliberately not a home for any one consumer's domain-specific transforms (e.g. WorldCheck- or State-Street-specific parsing stays downstream, in whichever service onboards that source). Plain static methods, registered into a flat runtime NamedTransformRegistry (fei's own NamedTransform/NamedTransformRegistry design, reused as-is) and dispatched by name from a mapper.fields[] spec - not MapStruct-qualified, and not a compile-time mapper concern. See D3 in the design plan (corrected 2026-09-12): an earlier draft proposed MapStruct @Named qualification here, which was a misapplication of MapStruct's real role in this org (JPA entity-to-model conversion, see forwardmeasure-data-streaming-connector-jdbc) onto the source/target payload mapping this module actually serves.
